description: Auto-resolve trivial Git merge conflicts using GitWand's pattern-based engine. Returns resolved files, DecisionTrace for each hunk, and pendingHunks for conflicts that need human/LLM review. Writes resolved files to disk unless dry_run is true.

cwd.description: Working directory (repo root). Defaults to server cwd.

dry_run.description: If true, analyze without writing files. Default: false.

files.description: Specific files to resolve. If omitted, discovers all conflicted files from git.

min_confidence_score.description: Apply only resolutions whose confidence scores >= this (0-100). Combined with the policy's own label threshold, never instead of it: raising it can only ever apply LESS, never more, so it can never let through a hunk the engine already refused. Omit to use the repo's .gitwandrc minConfidenceScore, or no bar at all.

policy.description: Merge policy to use. Default: prefer-theirs.

regenerate.description: If true, report GitWand's regenerate-tier plan (lockfile ecosystem + whether it's currently runnable) for any declined generated file (e.g. package-lock.json), reusing the same file states this call already computed. REPORTING ONLY — this never executes anything (no process spawned, no worktree created, no file written beyond what this tool already writes without the flag). To actually apply a plan, run `gitwand resolve --regenerate` (the CLI). Default: false.

name: gitwand_resolve_conflicts
